scope: Local diagnostic observation; no formal database or project state transition

diagnostic_artifact.log_capture_limitation: The user stopped Computer Use with physical Escape after the download action. Subsequent user photo demonstrates diagnostic color-bar output.

prior_031_result.user_report: Initially recognizes resolution, then no signal/standby; no picture throughout; no power cycle after programming

interpretation: The board, connected HDMI output, cable and monitor can display the supplied independent diagnostic pattern in this setup. Investigate the 031 design and its configuration next. A single photo does not establish long-term signal integrity or camera/DDR correctness.
known_031_review_findings: P13/N13 are used by 031 as reset/key inputs but described by the V4 manual as LED0/LED1; N14/P14 are used as LED outputs but described as KEY2/KEY1. Exact physical circuit consistency must be resolved before applying the existing button instructions.
031 display scanning and encoder reset depend on a combined four-PLL lock condition. Missing video frames alone should select black pixels without stopping scanning.
